name: mail-tresor
description: Trinity Mail env contract as a Tresor schema fragment: every mail env key (MAIL_*, RELAY_SMTP_*, RELAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, MAIL_BODY_KEY) declared with risk level, rotation policy, validation regex, and secret flag — mergeable into the project's tresor.config.ts, plus a mail env example
postMessage: Installed to ./tresor. 1) Merge the schema fragment into your Tresor config: `import { mailSecrets } from './mail.tresor'` then spread `...mailSecrets` into tresor.config.ts (see README). 2) Seed real values into tresor/vault.env from mail.env.example (NEVER commit vault.env); keep MAIL_DRIVER=console until you have relay credentials from `trinity-mail init`. 3) `tresor sync && tresor doctor` to generate + validate the runtime .env. Tests: `npx vitest run`. Note: this governs the SMTP/app env keys only — the Clausura wrap-key custody lives in the future Tresor-vault (Phase C, plan D-3), not here. Pairs with mail-client, mail-webhook, mail-dns, mail-templates.
